sentence_stem: Even though he studied all night,
full_sentence: Even though he studied all night, he still passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: he still felt ready for the test.
he still got a good grade.

options.text: so he passed the exam easily.
options.why_wrong: 'Even though' shows contrast, not result. 'So' introduces a result that does not fit the contrast.

options.text: he was very tired the next morning.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail but does not complete the contrast that 'even though' sets up.
'Because' gives a cause, which contradicts the contrast expected after 'even though'.

explanation: After 'even though', the main clause must show a result that goes against what we would expect. Learners often add a cause or result connector here by mistake, so check that the main clause contrasts with the first part.
translation: Bütün gece çalışmasına rağmen yine de sınavı geçti.
